Name: Husky's Expandable Greenhouse
Author: Huskyn1nja
Description:
This custom greenhouse currently has a total of 3 upgrades from Robin. The final upgrade gives access to a loft which can be configured in the settings. The loft either has space for additional crops, or for machines, chests, etc. 

Future updates and upgrades will be coming in the future.

As of 8/22/25 - 
Added Upgrade option for Auto Sprinklers
Added Upgrade option for Orchard
